lines.text: Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor, and Scripture says not to muzzle an ox treading grain.
An accusation against an elder needs two or three witnesses, and those who persist in sin are rebuked privately.
Paul solemnly charges Timothy to act without partiality and not to be too quick with the laying on of hands.
Timothy is told to use a little wine because of his stomach, and he is told that hidden good deeds stay hidden forever.

wrong_details.wrong: hidden good deeds stay hidden forever
wrong_details.true: even inconspicuous good deeds cannot remain hidden

lines.text: Slaves should honor their masters so God's name is not discredited, and serve believing masters all the more because they are brothers.
